messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning a tweak to the Weekly Digest nurture. Idea: split sends into 3 behavioral segments (high/med/low product engagement) and surface a tailored lead magnet + subject line for each. Want to run this for the Monday send window.

sam: Nice. What are the segmentation rules? can we do this without engineering work?

maya: segmentation rules (rough):
- high = used inference API in last 7 days OR >1000 tokens/day avg
- med = used in last 30 days but <7-day activity
- low = signed up but <30 days of activity OR no recent calls
We can do via the analytics export + the marketing list join. No infra changes. Need devex help for the personalization tokens.

olivia_k: love this. Subject line tests? also we should test a different CTA for each segment (high -> dedicated capacity trial; med -> benchmark invite; low -> get-started checklist).

jordan_pm: I like segment-level CTAs. For the lead magnets: high = cost/latency optimization playbook PDF, med = benchmark webinar invite, low = 5-minute quickstart + checklist.

sam: proposed subject lines (A/B):
- high_A: "Cut inference cost — advanced strategies for teams"
- high_B: "How teams cut LLM token costs by 2x"
- med_A: "Join our benchmark webinar: real-world latency wins"
- med_B: "See Redwood in action: 3 benchmark case studies"
- low_A: "New to Redwood? 5-minute checklist to ship LLM features"
- low_B: "Get started: checklist + templates for inference"

devex_annie: I'll add personalization tokens: {{first_name}}, {{org_size}}, {{last_seen}}. Need the CSV mapping from analytics. Also confirm suppression windows: opt-out, and don't email users who signed up <72 hours.

maya: yes — suppression rules: opted_out = exclude, recent_signup <72h exclude, bounced/invalid exclude. Also exclude anyone who received the product update digest last week (dedupe).

sam: tracking: use UTM template: `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_digest_v2&utm_content={{segment}}&utm_term={{subject_variant}}` — include an experiment id parameter `exp=wd_v2_2005` so analytics can join.

olivia_k: schedule: creative deadline: Thurs COB, QA + list prep Fri, soft send on Mon 10:00 PST for a small cohort (5%), ramp to 100% by Mon 11:00-13:00 PST depending on bounce rates.

jordan_pm: Can we do time-zone staggering? APAC prefers morning local. If we do 10:00 local for each region, we need to coordinate send windows. Ops can help with that.

devex_annie: send checklist for ENG/ops:
```
- Final CSV with segment tag column (high/med/low)
- Personalization tokens validated for 1k sample
- UTM + exp param on all links
- Suppression list files attached
- Test sends: 50 users per segment
```

marketing-bot: reminder: next-weekly-digest slot reserved for 2005-05-20. Assets due in marketing drive by 2025-05-15 17:00 UTC.

maya: action items: Olivia — finalize subject/preview + hero for each segment; Sam — set up UTM/experiment ids in links and prepare templates; Devex_Annie — prepare personalization tokens + test sends; Jordan — confirm lead magnet assets and webinar RSVP page. I'll own kickoff and QA.

olivia_k: I'll drop subject variations + hero comps by Wed EOD. sharing a quick mock now: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/abc123 (mock, do not share externally).

sam: planning note — keep the low segment email extremely light on technical jargon. Use social proof (customer quote) vs benchmarks.

maya: agree. Low = frictionless CTA. High = deeper docs + quant examples.

devex_annie: test plan: send to 50 internal accounts per segment tomorrow, capture opens, clicks, and routed events `newsletter.click` with exp id. Will report back by EOD.

jordan_pm: thumbs up, let's run the internal smoke then greenlight.

marketing-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled send job created for exp=wd_v2_2005, cohort=5%, status=queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya: thanks team. I'll post a follow-up when internal smoke passes. :thumbsup:
